recap.analyst:
Navigli United beat Harbor City 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.33–0.96: the scoreline flatters Navigli United, who were second-best on chance quality.

Harbor City had 68% of the ball. Pass completion NAV 69% (84/121), HAR 86% (248/288). Shots 3–8, on target 1–0.

Navigli United started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Harbor City in a 5-4-1 (direct). In-game changes: HAR to 3-4-3 at 71' (chasing the game); NAV to 5-4-1 at 81' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 28': Navigli United broke the deadlock through B. Kowalski. The chance was worth xG 0.15 (about 15 in 100 go in), struck at 102 km/h. Score now NAV 1-0 HAR. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: P. Reyes completed the most passes (51); B. Fuentes hit the top speed (33.4 km/h); B. Pavlov covered the most ground (6.17 km, a 17.7 km per-90 pace); Z. Fofana won the most challenges (10).

Discipline: fouls 2–5, yellows 1–2, reds 0–1, offsides 2–0. Conditions: overcast, 27°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Lombarda, Milan. B. Kowalski broke the deadlock in the 28th minute. And the red card changed everything. Harbor City pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 71st minute, but Navigli United held firm. The hero: B. Kowalski, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Navigli United celebrate in front of their fans.
